name: Chainsaw Fiend
description: The ultimate fiend form from the Chainsaw Man. Extremely powerful regeneration and devil consumption abilities.
passives: Devil Consumption: Absorb defeated devils to gain Fear
Chainsaw Regeneration: Extreme HP recovery
Fear Aura: Nearby enemies take passive damage
special: Can permanently delete devils by consuming them. The rarest and most powerful fiend.

name: Shark Fiend
description: High A-tier fiend with diving abilities. Fast M1 attacks that can be spammed effectively.
passives: Dive: Free combo extender ability
Fast M1: Rapid attack speed
Water Affinity: Faster in water areas
special: Dive acts as a free combo extender. Excellent for aggressive playstyles.

name: Violence Fiend
description: Mask-wearing fiend with incredible combat abilities. Must wear mask to control power.
passives: Masked Power: Controlled strength while masked
Unleashed: Remove mask for massive damage boost
Combat Expertise: Enhanced M1 combos
special: Can remove mask temporarily for massive damage at the cost of control.

name: Power Fiend
description: Blood manipulation fiend. Can create weapons from blood.
passives: Blood Manipulation: Create weapons from blood
Blood Spear: Ranged attack option
Regeneration: Heal by consuming blood
special: Versatile blood-based combat with both melee and ranged options.

name: Bomb Fiend
description: Explosive specialist. Creates bombs and deals AoE damage.
passives: Explosion Immunity: Immune to own explosions
Bomb Creation: Generate explosive projectiles
Blast Radius: Enhanced AoE damage
special: High AoE damage but risky at close range.

name: Spider Fiend
description: Web and trap specialist. Controls battlefield with webs.
passives: Web Trap: Slow enemies with webs
Wall Climb: Traverse vertical surfaces
Venom: Poison damage over time
special: Excellent crowd control and area denial.

name: Bat Fiend
description: Flying fiend with echolocation. Good for scouting and aerial combat.
passives: Flight: Can fly for extended periods
Echolocation: Detect hidden enemies
Night Vision: Enhanced vision in dark areas
special: Best mobility among fiends with flight capabilities.

name: Zombie Fiend
description: Undead fiend with high durability but slow speed. Good for beginners.
passives: Undead: Cannot be killed by normal means
Slow Regeneration: Passive health recovery
Fear Immunity: Immune to fear debuffs
special: Tanky fiend for players learning the game.
